explanation: δ(m, α) is the density of the n divisible by some d ≡ 1 (mod m) with 1 < d < exp(m^α), as on erdosproblems.com/697. The statement asserts that this density exists for all m and α. That is correct, since the set is a finite union of sets of multiples and hence periodic (for m = 0 the set is empty). It is a supporting result that makes δ well defined. Faithful.
